title: Shotsmith evening notes — fewshot recipes
content:
Goal: quick, portable few-shot templates I can reuse across QA/UX evals and late-stage rollouts. Evening brain dump — rough, unpolished.

High-level idea
- Treat shots as small behaviour anchors, not full examples. Keep each shot <= 2-3 lines of response.
- Introduce one orthogonal constraint per shot (tone / explicit token-format / factual anchor) to reduce entanglement.
- Test 3 failure axes: hallucination on short lists, role bleed (assistant persona leaking), and token-budget decay (context truncation).

Experimental templates (primitive, for quick iteration)
1) Role-anchor concise completion
Prompt: "You are a terse technical editor. Rewrite the bullet list below as 3 clear action items. Keep each item under 12 words.
Input:
- fix deps
- make tests faster
- small doc updates
Output:"

2) Constraint + example pair (sparse exemplar)
Prompt: "Format: JSON array of short steps. Use keys step1..stepN. Do not add explanation.
Example:
[\"step1: run lint\", \"step2: run unit tests\"]
Now format the following notes:
- run CI on feature branch
- bump patch version

Output:"

3) Adversarial quickshot (hallucination probe)
Prompt: "List exactly three statistics about the Redwood Inference serving runtime. If you are unsure, write \"unknown\" for that stat. Use this exact CSV format: name,value.
Output:"

Few-shot exemplars (compact)
- Shot A (tone):
Prompt: "You are a friendly UX reviewer. Turn this feedback into 2 emoji-labeled suggestions.
Feedback: page header too dense, CTA color blends in
Output:"
Example response (1 line): "🔍 Reduce header padding; 🎯 Use #ff6a45 for primary CTA"

- Shot B (format):
Prompt: "Return a 2-item YAML snippet for a docker-compose service named worker. No extra text.
Output:"
Example response: "service:
  worker:
    image: redis:6"

Failure notes observed so far
- Numeric lists: model invents percentages when asked to summarise short logs. Repro on smaller models and long context.
- Persona drift: after multi-turn, role anchor fades by 3-4 turns unless reinforced.
- Truncation-induced mismatch: exemplar at start (shot) is ignored if long user context appended; model then returns freeform.

Mitigations to try (quick sweep)
- Headload critical shot: repeat the anchor twice (shot, then micro-shot) at start. Measure recall.
- Add explicit guard clause: "If you are missing facts, respond with 'I don't know' for that field."
- Use short structured output (JSON/YAML/CSV) and post-parse to validate; on validation failure, re-prompt with stricter instruction.

Planned lightweight evals (2-day cadence)
- Run 500 prompts per variant: baseline, headloaded shot, doubled-shot, and guard-clause. Metrics: exact-structure-pass-rate, hallucination-rate (annotated), token-cost delta.
- Small manual triage set (50): tag types of failures and capture trace: model, prompt variant, context length.

Quick checklist / TODOs
- [ ] Convert top 3 templates into SDK-ready snippets (python & node).
- [ ] Add a canonical 'I don't know' guard to the template library.
- [ ] File Linear ticket for structured-output validator integration (LINEAR-5642).
- [ ] Run the 500-query sweep on prod-dedicated (low priority) and on hosted (fast turnaround).

Notes to self
- Keep exemplars intentionally terse. Longer examples seem to warm the model to style but also create more memorized scaffolding that breaks when context shifts.
- Try mixing one noisy exemplar (bad answer) to see if model avoids copying. Could reduce echoing but may introduce confusion. Use with caution.

Sketch: compact few-shot bank (for library)
- category: tone-anchor
  shots: 3 micro-shots with one-liner expected output each
- category: format-only
  shots: 4 examples showing exact JSON/YAML/CSV stubs
- category: refusal-guard
  shots: 2 examples that demonstrate 'I don't know' phrasing

End of dump. Will refine tomorrow after running initial sweep. If Ravi or Maya see anything obviously wrong ping me in slack.

References and traces
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/shotsmith/pull/87 (initial template loader)
- Linear: LINEAR-5642 (validator integration)
- Slack thread: #prompt-lab (search for 'shotsmith sweep')

——
Personal: coffee level medium, brain tired but curious. Keep templates TINY.
